mapper.sql: id, report_job_id, job_name, report_type, generation_mode, scope_type, scope_keywords, exclude_keywords, platform_scope, risk_levels, department_scope, monitor_task_ids, analysis_profile, template_id, event_id, ai_user_prompt, period_rule, schedule_cron, output_format, job_status, last_run_time, next_run_time, schedule_lock_until, reviewer_user_id, description, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_report_job ( report_job_id, job_name, report_type, generation_mode, scope_type, scope_keywords, exclude_keywords, platform_scope, risk_levels, department_scope, monitor_task_ids, analysis_profile, template_id, event_id, ai_user_prompt, period_rule, schedule_cron, output_format, job_status, last_run_time, next_run_time, schedule_lock_until, reviewer_user_id, description, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id ) VALUES ( #{reportJobId}, #{jobName}, #{reportType}, #{generationMode}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeKeywords}, #{excludeKeywords}, #{platformScope}, #{riskLevels}, #{departmentScope}, #{monitorTaskIds}, #{analysisProfile}, #{templateId}, #{eventId}, #{aiUserPrompt}, #{periodRule}, #{scheduleCron}, #{outputFormat}, #{jobStatus}, #{lastRunTime}, #{nextRunTime}, #{scheduleLockUntil}, #{reviewerUserId}, #{description}, #{deleted}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE campus_report_job SET job_status = #{jobStatus}, next_run_time = #{nextRunTime}, schedule_lock_until = NULL, update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE report_job_id = #{reportJobId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE campus_report_job SET last_run_time = NOW(), next_run_time = #{nextRunTime}, schedule_lock_until = NULL, update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE report_job_id = #{reportJobId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM campus_report_job WHERE report_job_id = #{reportJobId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM campus_report_job WHERE deleted = 0 AND job_status = 'active' AND next_run_time IS NOT NULL AND next_run_time <= #{now} AND (schedule_lock_until IS NULL OR schedule_lock_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_run_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
